research.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Robust Learning
description: Implemented image-classification baselines in PyTorch and evaluated robustness under distribution shifts.
Compared augmentation and calibration methods across 12 corruption settings using five random seeds.
Reduced expected calibration error from 8.4% to 5.1% on the held-out evaluation split.
Defined corruption severity groups and kept preprocessing, checkpoints and inference settings fixed across comparisons.
Conducted ablations on label smoothing, augmentation strength and temperature scaling to separate their effects.
Reported clean-data accuracy alongside robustness metrics to make accuracy-calibration tradeoffs explicit.
Wrote data-loading tests and saved configurations, environment versions and seed-level results for replication.

research.title: Summer Research Student - Dataset Quality
description: Audited 18,000 labels and documented annotation disagreements in an internal research report.
Created stratified data splits and leakage checks for reproducible model comparison.
Designed an annotation review protocol covering ambiguous labels, near-duplicates and class imbalance.
Reviewed disagreements with two student annotators and recorded decisions without overwriting the original labels.
Compared class distributions before and after filtering and identified categories with insufficient coverage.
Built feature-validation checks and experiment summaries for an internal demand-forecasting prototype.
Implemented time-based validation and compared seasonal baselines before testing tree-based forecasting models.
Investigated missing values, delayed records and feature drift, documenting risks for deployment.
Prepared a handover notebook explaining evaluation assumptions and limitations to the engineering team.

projects.name: Experiment Reproducibility Toolkit
description: Built configuration-based runners, seed tracking and aggregated confidence-interval reports.
Documented benchmark setup and added tests for split integrity and missing metrics.
Added resumable execution and explicit failure records to avoid silently excluding unsuccessful experiments.
Created a tutorial with a small synthetic dataset and a worked example of interpreting uncertainty.
Separated dataset configuration from training code and checked repeated runs for consistent split membership.

projects.name: Calibration Diagnostics Dashboard
description: Built reliability diagrams and class-level error summaries from saved prediction files.
Added subgroup filters and displayed sample sizes to discourage conclusions from sparse categories.
Compared expected calibration error under multiple binning schemes and documented estimator sensitivity.
Wrote tests for malformed probability vectors, missing labels and classes absent from the evaluation split.

projects.name: Small-Data Learning Study
description: Designed a course study comparing linear models, shallow networks and pretrained representations under restricted label budgets.
Evaluated five training-set sizes with fixed class balance and repeated subsampling.
Compared validation-based model selection with a deliberately overfit baseline to demonstrate evaluation leakage.
Recorded compute time and parameter count alongside classification accuracy.
Wrote a project report explaining why gains on one dataset did not establish general superiority.

projects.name: Model Error Review Workspace
description: Built a local workspace for reviewing misclassified examples and grouping errors by category.
Designed an annotation table retaining model version, confidence, review decision and reviewer notes.
Added export checks to prevent duplicate examples from entering both training and evaluation collections.
Analyzed error clusters with the research team and proposed targeted data-review tasks.
Documented that qualitative error categories were exploratory and required independent validation.
